chunk_map.heading: # Painting the picture with the LLM
## Two frontiers: how fast, and the right things

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read
rules_evaluated.evidence: Sequential read holds. Chunk1: wizard/auto-complete/LLM all named in-sentence; Godin named directly (§6 name-only carve-out); 'it' in 'the infinite version of it' resolves to the immediately preceding tool/taste argument. Chunk2: 'it'/'that' in 'You prime it. The LLM scales it.' resolve to 'the session'/'the context window' named two sentences earlier same chunk; shotgun/cannon is a self-contained metaphor, not a referent needing an antecedent. Chunk3: 'your setup' and 'it' both defined within the same sentence pair ('The rules and context you put in front of the LLM: can that stack learn...' / 'Once the setup can learn fast...'). No never-named, vague, or stranded referents found. Harm the rule prevents (a slide leaning on nothing) is absent throughout.
No pointers to other files by position. Godin is named-only, no location claim, no 'the opening lecture said' style callback anywhere in the file.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists
rules_evaluated.evidence: File is the opener of M1 (per Lecture meta: 'opener... before the wizard-move demo'); it contains no backward-pointing 'the X you did/saw/caught' references to any prior beat.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read
rules_evaluated.evidence: No guess-before-reveal structure in this file; maintainer's own watch-for confirms the two frontier questions are deliberately left unanswered rather than staged as a reveal ('do NOT answer them').

All three body chunks carry multiple self-carrying sentences (chunk1: wizard/autocomplete/mirror argument; chunk2: prime-and-scale + shotgun/cannon koan; chunk3: two named frontier questions + kicker). None is a bare wait-state bullet.

Chunk1 header 'The LLM mirrors your stance' is restated verbatim as the chunk's closing sentence. Chunk2 header 'You prime, the LLM scales' is restated verbatim two sentences in ('You prime it. The LLM scales it.'). Chunk3 header 'Two frontiers: how fast, and the right things' is cashed out by the chunk's own two questions ('How fast can your setup learn?' / 'Can it learn the right things?'). No header is contradicted by its chunk's content.

Not-X-Not-Y-Z: none found (closest is 'Auto-complete was a thing. Auto-complete is no longer a thing.' — a two-sentence contrast, not the banned triadic-negation shape). Anaphora/epistrophe triples: shotgun/cannon is a deliberate two-leg pair (maintainer accept-note line 31), no third leg to fail on. Self-grading superlatives: none present anywhere in the body — sub-item PASS (blocking sub-item clean). Number+retraction: no numbers appear in the body at all, N/A. Abstraction-noun stacks: 'context window' and 'stack' are used as plain engineering terms with concrete referents, not abstraction-stacking. Verb triplets with an empty leg: 'The LLM can do good work and bad work. It will be what fits the session. The LLM mirrors your stance.' has three sentences but different subjects/predicates, none is a padding verb-triplet with a leg that fails 'what does this concretely mean?'.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Heading grammar is the mood switch
rules_evaluated.evidence: This is a lecture, so headings should be claims. Chunk1 ('The LLM mirrors your stance') and chunk2 ('You prime, the LLM scales') are full-sentence claims, both restated verbatim inside their own chunk content — clean. Chunk3's header, 'Two frontiers: how fast, and the right things,' is label-shaped rather than a truth-claim sentence — the closest-to-violating specimen in the file. Judged PASS-by-exception rather than REVISE: the maintainer's own watch-for ('Frontiers section names two open questions — do NOT answer them... The training answers by accretion through M1–M6') establishes that the section's entire content is two deliberately unresolved questions, so a claim-shaped heading would misstate content the file is intentionally not asserting yet. Forcing a declarative heading here would create the exact defect rule 6 bans (header the chunk's own content contradicts). No harm from the label shape reaches the reader; the open-question framing is legible as its own move.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: No action needed given the deliberate open-question design; if a future pass wants full rule-15 compliance, the header would need to become a claim that names the two-frontier idea without resolving either question (e.g. a phrasing like 'Two open questions decide the setup' would still need maintainer sign-off as a body-text change).
